summary:
Our project introduces an interactive space adventure set in the year 2560, where players experience the challenges of a future space mission. As the astronaut travels through space, the spacecraft encounters various technical problems and damaged systems. To overcome these challenges, players must discover, collect, and repurpose space debris orbiting Earth, using suitable materials to restore their spacecraft.

Through this game, we aim to demonstrate that space debris is not only a growing threat to space missions but also an opportunity to explore innovative recycling solutions. Players learn about space environments, resource conservation, and sustainability while improving their critical thinking and decision-making skills.

We developed our original game concept using prompts in Google AI Studio and used Gamma to create a presentation explaining the game's purpose and real-world benefits. Our project combines education, creativity, and sustainability to inspire a more responsible approach to the future of space exploration.We developed a game

And in our slide presentation we used gamma for design and some translations but the words are ours. The idea is %100 our teams imagination.
